title: Retrospective Study to Review Patients at Risk for VTE at Hospital Discharge
brief_summary: An investigator initiated study exploring VTE prophylaxis at the time of hospital discharge.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acutely ill medical and surgical patients with a risk score of 4 or greater without prophylaxis or a risk score of 4 or greater with anticoagulation at hospital discharge.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None.
study_population: Acutely ill medical and surgical patients who were hospitalized at BWH and who are at risk for DVT.
